verdict.rationale: The Literature agent explicitly performs large-scale synthesis 'across hundreds of papers' with 175M+ paper access, and the client API supports submitting many jobs and querying results later (batch task submission, run_tasks_until_done), enabling a researcher to apply the same query/criteria across many papers programmatically. However, there is no documentation of a dedicated systematic-screening workflow (e.g., inclusion/exclusion criteria, structured extraction fields, PRISMA-style tracking) — the evidence shows general literature synthesis and batch job APIs, not a purpose-built screening/extraction pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit systematic-review/screening features (criteria-based inclusion/exclusion), structured field extraction across papers, and independent evidence of consistent-criteria application at scale.
